cohort: 74 women with Turner syndrome (TS) who underwent oocyte donation (OD) treatment (105 pregnancies) and 31 women with TS who had 71 spontaneous conceptions
finding: Pregnancy in women with Turner syndrome (TS), whether achieved through oocyte donation or spontaneously, is associated with obstetric risks.
mod_finding: Oocyte donation pregnancies in women with TS were associated with increased rates of LSCS and SGA compared to spontaneous pregnancies.
